hero.tagline: Integrated Model for Clinical Simulation Training in Emergency and Critical Care in Cross-Border Environments
hero.subtitle: A POCTEP project to transform healthcare training in emergency medicine on both sides of the Spanish-Portuguese border

proyecto.title: The Project
proyecto.subtitle: SIM4UE addresses a shared challenge across cross-border territories
proyecto.p1: SIM4UE is a project co-funded by the Interreg VI-A Spain-Portugal (POCTEP) 2021-2027 programme, responding to the urgent need to improve healthcare in emergency and critical care in the cross-border regions of Spain and Portugal.
proyecto.p2: Through the development of a Virtual Learning Environment for Simulation, SIM4UE integrates innovative pedagogical methodologies, immersive technologies (Virtual Reality, Augmented Reality, Artificial Intelligence) and bilingual training content, with the goal of strengthening the clinical competencies of healthcare professionals and improving cross-border cooperation.
proyecto.p3: The project runs from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2028, with a total budget of €4,725,090 and the participation of six healthcare and academic institutions from Spain and Portugal.
proyecto.obj1: Develop a Virtual Learning Environment through Simulation for open health training in emergency and critical care.
proyecto.obj2: Design and deploy a multi-device online tool integrating innovative didactic content, clinical simulations and training resources in Spanish and Portuguese.
proyecto.obj3: Integrate personalised learning pathways, continuous improvement of clinical competencies and cross-border cooperation aimed at improving clinical practice.

socios.title: Project Partners
socios.subtitle: Six leading institutions from Spain and Portugal working together

partners.name: Fundación Pública Andaluza Progreso y Salud
partners.desc: Andalusian public institution of reference in healthcare simulation training. IAVANTE is the simulation and educational innovation unit of the Fundación Progreso y Salud.

partners.name: University of Santiago de Compostela
partners.desc: One of the oldest and most prestigious universities in Europe. Leads the comprehensive evaluation studies, impact analysis and dissemination of project results.

partners.name: Centro Hospitalar de Trás-os-Montes e Alto Douro
partners.desc: Reference hospital in northeast Portugal. Leads the design and delivery of training scenarios in pre-hospital emergency and critical care.

partners.name: Hospital Virgen del Rocío
partners.desc: High-complexity university hospital with national and international reference. Responsible for designing and implementing simulation scenarios for obstetric emergencies.

partners.name: Centro Hospitalar e Universitário de Coimbra
partners.desc: Leading hospital and university centre in Portugal. Leads the design, validation and delivery of training scenarios for hospital emergencies.

partners.name: Junta de Andalucía – FISEVI
partners.desc: Foundation for Health Research in Seville (FISEVI). Collaborates in the development of the shared model for training clinical simulation facilitators.

actividades.title: Project Activities
actividades.subtitle: Six structured activities to transform cross-border healthcare training

items.title: Virtual Learning Environment
items.desc: Development of a multi-device online platform with innovative didactic content, clinical simulations, immersive technologies (VR, AR, AI) and personalised learning pathways in Spanish and Portuguese.

items.title: Shared Simulation Model
items.desc: Development of a common competency framework and pedagogical objectives, design of the course model for initial facilitator training and delivery of 5 editions.

items.title: Adult Emergency Training
items.desc: Design, validation and delivery of training scenarios in hospital emergencies and pre-hospital care, with comprehensive evaluation and impact analysis.

items.title: Paediatric & Obstetric Emergencies
items.desc: Design, piloting and implementation of simulation scenarios for paediatric and obstetric emergencies, with comprehensive evaluation and dissemination of results.

items.title: Management & Coordination
items.desc: Progress monitoring and reporting, management of protocols and internal communication channels, implementation of a Risk Management and Quality Assurance Plan.

items.title: Visibility, Transparency & Communication
items.desc: Communication plan and social media presence, identification of transferability to other European regions.

noticias.title: News
noticias.subtitle: Latest updates from the SIM4UE project

items.title: SIM4UE project kick-off meeting
items.desc: Project partners gather at the launch meeting to establish the work plan, milestones and project roadmap for the next three years.

items.title: SIM4UE officially launches
items.desc: The SIM4UE project officially starts on 1 January 2026, supported by the Interreg VI-A Spain-Portugal (POCTEP) programme and with the participation of six cross-border partners.

items.title: Pedagogical Architecture Design
items.desc: In the coming weeks, the FPS/IAVANTE team will begin a comparative analysis of clinical simulation platforms and tools at European and international level.
